title: ToolTurns: Benchmarking LLM Agents in Multi-Turn Dialogue
author: Milad Gholami, Brendan King, Jeffrey Flanigan
description: arXiv:2611.14925v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Tool-using language models are increasingly deployed in conversational settings, yet most large-scale tool-use benchmarks focus on isolated requests. We introduce ToolTurns, a benchmark of 2,620 problems spanning 1,827 tools and 11,004 API endpoints across 47 categories.…
